name: Trickshot Champion (Scout Archetype)
body:
Trickshot champions take pride in their work, often more haughty and boisterous than other scouts. Showmanship empowers their dazzling throwing techniques.

Boastful Grit (Ex)

The trickshot champion uses their Charisma instead of their Wisdom for their grit pool and any DCs or effects of their deeds.

This ability modifies grit and deeds, but does not prevent abilities from replacing those abilities.

Bullseye (Ex)

At 1st level, the trickshot champion suffers no penalty on Perception checks due to distance within 200 feet and their sneak attacks use d8s rather than d6s when using thrown weapons. All other weapons use d4s for sneak attack damage.

This ability modifies sneak attack.

Around the World (Ex)

At 1st level, the trickshot champion gains the trick shot deed except that it does not cost any grit points to activate.

This ability replaces trapfinding.

Drop the Hammer (Ex)

At 8th level, when the trickshot champion uses Vital Strike with a thrown weapon, any ricochets from the initial attack also gain the benefit of Vital Strike. This ability replaces covert expert.

The following deeds are gained in place of deeds normally gained by the scout.

Balanced Thrower (Ex)

Beginning with 3rd level, while the scout has at least 1 grit point, any one handed, light weapon sized appropriately for the trickshot champion gains a non-magical version of the throwing and returning special weapon properties.

This replaces the trick shot deed normally gained at 3rd level.

Go Long (Ex)

Beginning with 7th level, while the trickshot champion has at least 1 grit point the range increment of all weapons they throw is doubled and the distances listed for the trick shot deed also double.

This deed replaces the canny resilience deed normally gained at 7th level.
